item.title: Show HN: Overcheck – self-hosted uptime monitoring, API and multi-user access
item.summary: Built this little side project to address a few limitations with self-hosted monitoring tools. Overcheck has things I found missing in others, such as a REST API and multi-user roles. It supports HTTP, TCP, ping, and keyword checks, plus Slack, email, and webhook alerts. Configuration is done via yaml. Happy to hear feedback about this early release version.
